tagline: One board for your coding agents.
brief: A shared task board for one person operating coding agents across repositories. The identity should be clear in a browser tab, restrained in a dashboard, and at home in developer documentation.
criteria: The selected F keeps two separate work streams in one compact initial. Works in a single colour, with an adjusted small-size drawing and a lighter reversed symbol.

concepts.name: Parallel F
concepts.idea: Independent work streams resolve into one clear F.
rationale: The selected silhouette is retained: two pieces, one 24-unit channel, exact 45-degree terminals.
Burnt orange provides a warm signature beside dark ink and off-white.
The outlined monospace wordmark uses custom spacing; the small cut aligns its bars to a 16-pixel grid.

recommendation: The identity is ready for use as an asset kit. Mockups illustrate placement; they do not represent changes to the application.
next_steps: Use the horizontal colour artwork on light surfaces and the white artwork on dark surfaces.
Use the supplied small cut below 24 px, and copy the web folder as a set when adopting the icons.
Review the usage guide before print production; spot colours and trademark clearance are not certified.
